_README: Read by core/model_window.py. HUMAN-tunable only, like config/scheduler.json
and config/step_priority.json — a system that can widen its own access to the
expensive model has no model budget.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Measured on this box 22 Aug 2026 via /api/ps: qwen2.5:3b
and qwen3:8b never coexist. 4GB of VRAM holds one of them, so every call to one
fully evicts the other, and 8b does not fit even alone (3.32GB of 5.75GB
resident; the other 42% runs on the CPU). Alternating them costs a full reload
each time — 7-14s warm, minutes cold — charged to whichever step is running.
window_opens_at_step      first step at which qwen3:8b may be loaded
window_closes_after_step  last such step; after it, 8b is unloaded and 3b is
reloaded pinned (keep_alive=-1)
enabled                   false = 8b denied everywhere (3b only, all cycle)
THE BOUNDARY IS A JUDGEMENT AND IT IS MEANT TO BE ARGUED WITH. The default is
the reasoning tail: the front of the cycle ACQUIRES data, where cloud plus 3b
are enough, and the tail REASONS about what was acquired, which is the work a
bigger model is actually for. Consequence worth saying out loud:
internet_intelligence — one of the two steps the existence ledger blames for
kills (6 each) — sits OUTSIDE the window and will be served 3b. That is the
intended trade: it is a fetch step, and a fetch step that degrades is cheaper
than a cycle that dies.
Steps are matched by POSITION in core/cycle_map.py STEPS, not by a name list,
so a step inserted between these two endpoints joins the window automatically.
